description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminPanel ASP.NET webpage in the online examination system, handling page events and button clicks that navigate to different pages.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Partial class for handling server-side events for the AdminPanel web page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load; currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for Home button click; currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles profile button click, transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles leaderboard button click, transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles set exam button click, transfers to SetExam.aspx.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles edit exam button click, transfers to EditExam.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout button click, transfers to LoginPage.aspx.
